items.description: Cloudflare is a global cloud connectivity company offering one platform spanning developer infrastructure (serverless compute, storage, AI inference), application security (WAF, DDoS, bot management, API Shield), Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and network services (CDN, DNS, load balancing, Magic Transit); it serves developers, security teams and enterprise IT
cloudflare.com is the marketing/product site; technical documentation lives at developers.cloudflare.com
Every page on cloudflare.com is available as markdown by appending .md to its URL
llms-full.txt: expanded version with all product content inline
Pricing hub, including usage-based pricing for developer platform services (Workers, storage, AI, media)
Network & CDN pricing: Free, Pro, Business and Contract domain plans with feature comparisons and add-ons
SASE / Zero Trust pricing: Free, pay-as-you-go and Contract seat-based plans
Developer platform product pages (compute, storage, AI, media): Workers, Containers, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Workers AI, Agents, AI Gateway, Vectorize, Images, Stream, etc.
Application security product pages: WAF, DDoS Protection, Bot Management, Turnstile, API Shield, Rate Limiting, SSL, Spectrum, etc.
Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One) product pages: Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG), Browser Isolation, DLP, CASB, Email Security, Magic Transit, Magic WAN, Network Firewall
Network & performance product pages: CDN, DNS, Load Balancing, Argo Smart Routing, Analytics, China Network, Email Routing, etc.
Solution pages by use case and industry (AI, Security, Network, Platforms, Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector, Retail)
Network scale: 335+ cities in 125+ countries, 500 Tbps capacity, 13,000+ interconnected networks, within 50 ms of 95% of Internet users, GPUs in 220+ cities; handles ~20% of web traffic
Company facts: founded 2010, public since 2019 (NYSE: NET); 42% of Fortune 500 are paying customers; largest DDoS mitigated 31.4 Tbps (Nov 2025)

Free offerings include Turnstile (CAPTCHA replacement), SSL certificates, DNS, Email Routing; R2 has zero egress fees; Workers run on V8 isolates with zero cold starts and deploy globally, not to regions
